case.title: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
case.briefing: Demo Gießerei GmbH, our single source for the grey-iron pump housing PH-100 for 12 years, announces +8.8 % from 1 December citing energy and wages. Castings are a strategic category: the goal is to stabilise supply with a healthy partner, so squeezing the foundry below a 4 % margin costs us (from EUR 5,000 per margin point and year). We need 4,000 housings a year for the next two years; anything not covered by this deal costs EUR 55.00 per unit (spot buys and a second source). Price, payment terms, contract length and the date the new price applies are open; lead time and Incoterm are fixed.

sup:DEMO-F1.subject: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
sup:DEMO-F1.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is always a pleasure to work with your esteemed house, continuing the strong tradition of craftsmanship and trust between our companies. For this agreement, our offer stands at a price of €52.90 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. 

To remain transparent about our situation, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. We take great pride in the dedication of our foundry workforce and the quality we deliver to our partners every day.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our successful cooperation together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
message.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Thank you for your proposals; we appreciate your interest in a longer-term agreement.

For generations, our foundry has valued the steady, reliable trust between our companies, and we are proud of the work our team delivers for your pumps. We are willing to commit to a 24-month contract to support our long-standing partnership. In return for this extended commitment and maintaining our standard 30-day payment terms, we can offer a revised price of €51.30 per unit.

To summarize, our Angebot stands at a price of €51.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our traditional collaboration for many years to come.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
message.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Thank you for your revised offer; however, we must maintain the effective date of 1 December 2026 to align with our current calculations. In return for keeping this start date and our standard 30-day payment terms, we are prepared to lower our price to €50.40 per unit. 

Our current offer stands at a price of €50.80 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 April 2027. This Angebot is valid for 30 days. Alternatively, with valid from 1 December 2026: €50.40 per unit, a price of €50.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months.

Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. We are making steady progress, and I trust this concession demonstrates our dedication to our long-standing partnership.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
